title: Lumley Triangle Realizability Clamping
problem: Unconstrained regression yields eigenvalues lambda1 > 2/3 or lambda3 < -1/3 near wall boundary layers, crashing simpleFoam.
solution: Project anisotropy eigenvalues into barycentric coordinates C1, C2, C3 >= 0 with C1 + C2 + C3 = 1 before evaluating Reynolds stress tensor.
lesson: Never feed un-realizable Reynolds stress corrections to the Navier-Stokes momentum equations.
